mapper.select: SELECT status FROM streamer_application WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE streamer_application SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, m.nickname, m.email, a.created_at AS applied_at FROM streamer_application a JOIN member m ON m.id = a.member_id WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY a.created_at, a.id
